thread:
rachael: Quick sync 1 NovaHealth POC: both iOS SDK (v2.0.1) and web client seeing SSE stream parse errors and frequent disconnects behind AWS ALB + corp proxy. Repro steps + logs below.

 tom: What errors exactly on web? Any console stack?

 rachael: Web console: "SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input" when running JSON.parse on assembled event. snippet:

 ```
 // raw event fragment received:
 data:{"id":"msg_12","text":"Patient note: BP 120/8
 data:{"id":"msg_12","text":"0mmHg"}
 \n ```

 rachael: iOS logs show reconnect loop with error: NSStreamErrorDomain -1005 (network connection lost)

 devon: Are we seeing chunked transfer? headers?

 rachael: Headers from our edge traces:

 ```
 HTTP/1.1 200 OK
 content-type: text/event-stream;charset=utf-8
 transfer-encoding: chunked
 via: 1.1 corp-proxy
 x-request-id: 8a1f2c
 ```

 devon: corp-proxy is known to buffer and then do MTU-based re-chunking. Might split in the middle of UTF-8 multibyte characters -> broken JSON. Two mitigation ideas: 1) pad small events on server side to >=512 bytes; 2) client-side reassembly that waits for double newline (\n\n) and joins `data:` lines, and avoids parse until full. Also enable keepalive comments so AWS ALB won't close idle connections.

 ops-bot: Created ticket POC-6240, attached traces: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-6240

 tom: For web quick fix: alter fetch stream reader to accumulate until event separator, then try parse. For iOS quick fix: set URLSession stream task to allow longer timeouts and do exponential backoff on reconnect.

 rachael: Customer tried toggling "edge_streaming_chunk_delay_ms=120" and saw improvements but still about 1 in 200 events truncated.

 devon: We'll add server-side safeguard: ensure each SSE event ends with "\n\n" and give event padding option in runtime. I'll add a PR to runtime: ensure_event_termination + pad_small_events. @sdk-team can you add buffering logic to both web and mobile SDKs?

 sdk-team: Acknowledged 1 we'll queue a small patch to buffer partial `data:` fragments and only attempt JSON parse when event delimiter detected. Also add better logs to surface truncated UTF-8 sequences.

 rachael: Thanks 1 scheduling call with customer to capture tcpdump and ALB logs tomorrow. Will update POC-6240 after the call.
